added.title: Senior Engineering Manager- Design Systems & Accessibility
added.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for a technically strong, highly collaborative, and passionate leader for our Slack Kit & Accessibility engineering team! This team builds and maintains Slack's UI design system and frontend component library (Slack Kit) that powers every surface across Slack, all while championing accessibility as a first-class part of how Slack is built. The team partners closely with design and product engineering teams across the company to ensure new and existing features meet a high bar for usability, consistency, and accessibility.

What You Will Be Doing

With your Product and Design counterparts, drive Slack's accessibility strategy, partnering with teams across Slack to ensure new and existing UX patterns are accessible and usable by everyone, including users relying on screen readers and keyboard navigation.
Own and continually evolve Slack Kit, Slack's design system and component library, to deliver a consistent experience for end users while making it fast and easy for designers and engineers across the company to build product features.
Help set technical direction and facilitate execution for major Frontend Engineering initiatives, such as modernizing Slack’s CSS architecture.
With IC leads, develop clear roadmaps and milestones to enable the team to execute on multi-quarter projects.
Provide regular feedback, coaching, and seek out growth opportunities for your team to help them continually level up technically and grow their careers.
Build a sustainable high performing team and a work environment that's both supportive and challenging.

Required Skills

3+ years leading software engineering teams.
Previous experience as a Senior+ Frontend Software Engineer.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational, and time management skills.
Experience hiring, mentoring, and leading engineers.
Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.
You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent training, fellowship, or work experience.

Nice To Have

Experience with design systems and/or UI component libraries.
Experience championing the needs of people, use cases, or initiatives outside your own lived experience or day-to-day work.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $260,100 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $207,800 - $285,800 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

added.title: Director of National Development, Engineering
added.description:
Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary range available for this position at the time of its posting. The salary range is between $71,041 and $89,867, depending on qualifications, experience, department budgets, and industry data.

Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

The director of national development has a primary responsibility for the strategic solicitation of individual gifts for the Case School of Engineering. This position is responsible for identifying, cultivating, soliciting and stewarding 125 prospects, including alumni, and non-alumni and a targeted group of local and national corporations and foundations for gifts of $100,000 to $250,000. Functioning as part of a university-wide development team, the incumbent will be expected to work collegially, and in partnership, with school-based colleagues and develop strong relationships with central development personnel and university trustees. This position will require that approximately 80% of their time be spent on direct face-to-face cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of donors and participate in planning and implementing school initiatives.

Essential Functions

Plan strategies for the identification, cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of gifts for a portfolio of 125 major gifts prospects with a giving potential in the range of $100,000 to $250,000; develop and implement strategic cultivation and solicitation strategies with the responsibility of raising private support and the achievement of personal fundraising goals. Develop and implement major gift prospect cultivation activities regionally and nationally in coordination with development and alumni relations colleagues. (65%)
Serve as development staff contact for chairs and other senior faculty; work with departments in the planning and implementation of departmental fundraising. Develop strategies to build a strong relationship with corporation and foundation partners, which may include the dean, associate dean and other senior staff of the school, president, provost and senior vice president of development and university relations. Develop major gift strategies that leverage corporation and foundation partnerships with on campus activities. (10%)
Serve as a member of the development staff and assist with the development and implementation of program strategies and overall departmental development plans to fulfill the mission of the school and the university. (10%)
Identify, qualify, recruit, train and manage alumni volunteers as appropriate, who will actively participate in the soliciting of gifts of all levels. Partner with volunteers to engage and cultivate individuals who have capacity to make gifts of $100,000 to $250,000 to the school. (10%)

Nonessential Functions

Provide assistance with other funding priorities as determined by the senior director of national development. (4%)
Perform other duties as assigned by the senior director of national development. (1%)

CONTACTS

Department: Frequent contact with dean, associate/assistant deans, department chairs, directors, faculty, students and staff as required to perform essential functions.

University: Contact with the president's office, vice presidents, deans, trustees, alumni, directors of administrative departments, faculty and staff as required to perform essential functions.

External: Daily contact with donors, alumni, foundation representatives, community organizers/advocates, corporate executives and federal, state and local government officials. Contact with visitors, academic boards and organizations as required to perform essential functions.

Students: Contact with undergraduate, graduate and professional students as required to perform essential functions.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No direct supervisory responsibility.

Qualifications

Experience: 7 or more years of professional experience required. Experience in higher education, including the areas of development, alumni relations, public relations, marketing or related fields preferred.

Education: Bachelor's degree required; prefer Master's degree.

Required Skills

High degree of energy, creativity, organization and interpersonal skills as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills required.
Must be able to work both independently and collaboratively with colleagues.
Computer proficiency (including Microsoft Office) and the ability to learn new programs.
Ability to demonstrate history of successful support, education, and advocacy for all students, aligned with the values, mission, and messaging of the university, while adhering to the staff policy on conflict of commitment and interest.
Ability to meet consistent attendance.
Ability to interact with colleagues, supervisors, and customers face to face.
Willingness to learn and work with artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies.

WORKING CONDITIONS

General office environment, some evening and weekend work hours will be required. Extensive travel required.

This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangement up to two remote days per week at the discretion of the department. New employees may begin a hybrid schedule upon approval from the supervisor, successful completion of an orientation period and signing the remote work checklist certification form.

Case Western Reserve University is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants are protected under federal and state laws and university policy from discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, protected veteran status, disability, age and genetic information.

Case Western Reserve University complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act regarding reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process should contact the CWRU Office of Equity at 216-368-3066 to request a reasonable accommodation. Determinations as to granting reasonable accommodations for any applicants will be made on a case-by-case basis.

added.title: Executive Director, Engineering - Xumo Platform
added.description:
Xumo, a joint venture between Comcast and Charter Communications, was formed to develop and offer a next-generation streaming platform for the entire entertainment industry. The company consists of three primary lines of business: Xumo devices, Xumo Play, and Xumo Enterprise. Powered by Comcast’s global entertainment platform, Xumo devices feature a world-class user interface with universal voice search capabilities, making it easy for consumers to find and enjoy their favorite streaming content. Xumo Play is a free ad-supported streaming TV (FAST) service offering hundreds of linear channels and on-demand options. Xumo Enterprise provides tools and services for content creators, distributors, and advertisers to make FAST content more accessible.

Job Summary

The role is instrumental in driving measurable growth across Xumo FAST (Play and Enterprise) businesses by setting platform engineering strategy, overseeing fiscal and operational performance, developing leaders, advancing scalable monetization, personalization, security, privacy, accessibility, and governance capabilities while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing engineering culture.

Job Description

Highly Preferred Qualifications/Ideal Experience:

Deep experience leading engineering organizations responsible for video, advertising technology, and data platforms at scale.
Proven success building and evolving cloud-based platform architectures that support high-volume consumer & enterprise products.
Experience scaling platforms from early-stage development through significant user growth.
Strong understanding of video streaming ecosystems, advertising technology, audience data, and platform monetization capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity & drive results in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Track record of managing & developing engineering leaders and established teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and high performance.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to partner effectively across product, data, operations, and business organizations.
Position is office based in Irvine, CA -4 days a week in office/1 day remote.

Responsibilities

Orchestrating engineering strategies aligned with Xumo FAST platform architecture across Video, Ad Tech, Data, Content Management System, and Backend domains, while fostering an environment that embraces continuous improvement and change.
Driving business objectives by implementing strategies that ensure operational excellence, accountability, and measurable impact on monetization, user engagement, and platform efficiency across the engineering organization.
Defining and overseeing execution of cross-functional, platform-level initiatives, ensuring alignment between Engineering, Product, and business priorities, and supporting delivery of large-scale, high-impact programs.
Directing data-driven analysis of operational and business metrics, monitoring project timelines, platform performance, and expenditures to ensure alignment with ROI and strategic priorities.
Managing comprehensive budget oversight, including forecasting for platform operations, development, and large-scale engineering initiatives supporting both Xumo Play and Enterprise businesses.
Leading platform development initiatives, including monetization capabilities such as advertising systems, data-driven personalization, and revenue-enabling technologies, translating these into scalable and maintainable platform solutions.
Benchmarking and optimizing work processes to meet company and industry performance standards, including improvements in system scalability, reliability, cost efficiency, and operational excellence across platform engineering.
Monitoring competitors, industry developments, and technological advances across streaming media, AVOD, and FAST markets to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, and inform platform direction.
Championing professional development by mentoring engineering leaders and building a strong leadership bench across Directors, Senior Managers, and Principal Engineers, enabling organizational scalability.
Inspiring team commitment, building shared vision, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing engineering culture across onshore and offshore teams.
Leading data security, privacy, accessibility, and governance across platform systems by applying industry best practices, supporting global privacy compliance frameworks, maintaining audit readiness, and coordinating cross-functional execution.
Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Employees At All Levels Are Expected To

Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
Drive results and growth.
Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

Disclaimer:
This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

Strategy Implementation; Operational Excellence; Collaboration; Platform Architecture; Platform Engineering; Cost Efficiency; People Leadership

Pay Range: This job can be performed in California with a good faith estimated pay range upon hire of $235,942.23 - $314,589.64 USD.

added.title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
added.description:
About the Opportunity

The company is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. It addresses a significant economic inefficiency: millions of highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing substantial forgone wages and untapped productivity for the economy. The organization's model has proven effective, with jobseekers entering programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and being placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, the organization has supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy. The organization is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. It is committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. The organization operates nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes an American advantage.

This role is responsible for building and leading the organization's technology strategy and infrastructure to support both internal operations and externally facing digital products. This includes staff-facing technology as well as the technical infrastructure that enables jobseeker and partner experiences. This leader partners closely with the CEO, President, and executive leadership to ensure technology is a strategic enabler of the organization's mission, helping the organization transition towards an AI and product-first model while maintaining strong operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. The organization will integrate AI into all aspects to drive operational excellence, improve jobseeker opportunities and outcomes, and this role will help lead these efforts. The VP of Technology is expected to be both strategic and execution-oriented: setting direction, making tradeoffs clear, and delivering consistently across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & AI Infrastructure
Own the organization's technology strategy across staff infrastructure and jobseeker/partner-facing products, ensuring both are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned to mission outcomes.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering staff infrastructure and IT operations, data systems and reporting, Salesforce/platform evolution, core digital products (jobseeker portal, online learning, partner tools), and integrations/interoperability across systems.
Translate organizational strategy into a sequenced plan with clear timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures.
Provide clear tradeoffs and recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team on what to prioritize, defer, or stop based on capacity and impact.
Support sprint planning, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.

Product & Engineering Partnership (Jobseeker + Partner Products)
Partner deeply with Product leadership to deliver a reliable, scalable technology foundation for the organization's jobseeker and partner ecosystem.
Ensure strong cross-functional delivery across product/tech/programs, including planning, prioritization, technical feasibility, timelines, and adoption/change management.
Partnering with the Product Director, guide the technical approach to product delivery (architecture, build vs. buy, integration strategy, platform choices) and ensure consistent execution quality.

AI Enablement and Responsible Technology Innovation
Partner with the Executive team, Product, and Program leadership to identify and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve jobseeker outcomes and staff productivity.
With a cross-department steering committee, establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI use, including data privacy and consent, security controls and vendor risk assessment, quality assurance and bias considerations, and human oversight/escalation paths.
Build the technical foundation required for AI-readiness: data quality, integration, and scalable infrastructure to support AI features and experimentation.

IT Operations, Service Delivery and Training (Staff & Product Infrastructure)
Lead internal IT operations to ensure strong service delivery across the organization (helpdesk, devices, access control, onboarding/offboarding, troubleshooting).
Establish service standards (response times, escalation, documentation, internal communications) and continuously improve the staff technology experience.
Own vendor relationships and contracts across key systems and managed service providers.
Ensure all staff are trained to use the infrastructure and tools, including AI, to maximum effect. Delivery includes accountability to staff usage, ensuring technology is utilized with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.

Systems, Data, and Platform Leadership (Salesforce + Reporting)
Oversee Salesforce and related systems as the operational backbone for Programs, Development, and organizational reporting.
Strengthen system usability, adoption, and reliability through clear requirements gathering, prioritization, and iterative improvements.
Own data strategy in partnership with research and evaluation leadership: governance, quality, reporting, and dashboard reliability.
Ensure the organization has trusted reporting that supports program improvement, fundraising narratives, and leadership decision-making.

Project Delivery, Execution Discipline & Cross-Functional Leadership
Implement and enforce a consistent project management framework across all technology work.
Lead cross-functional execution so teams experience IT and technology as reliable, transparent, and partnership-driven.
Build a culture of accountability and follow-through within the technology function and across stakeholders.

Security, Risk, and Compliance
Own cybersecurity strategy and operational risk management.
Ensure appropriate controls for systems that handle sensitive data.
Maintain risk register and communicate risks and mitigations clearly to the Executive Leadership Team and the Board as needed.
Ensure technology practices align with funder requirements, privacy expectations, and organizational policies.

Executive Partnership & Communication
Serve as a proactive, consultative partner to the CEO, President, and Executive Leadership Team, bringing clear updates, risks, and decision-ready recommendations.
Communicate in a structured way leadership can act on: what is on track, what is at risk, what decisions are needed, and what tradeoffs are recommended.
Drive follow-through on Executive Leadership Team decisions by documenting commitments, assigning owners, and reporting progress.

Success Measures
A clear, sequenced technology roadmap that covers staff infrastructure and digital products, aligned to strategic priorities.
Strong Product-Tech partnership resulting in reliable delivery of jobseeker and partner-facing features and improvements.
AI capabilities delivered responsibly with governance, safety standards, and measurable impact.
Predictable project delivery with improved cross-functional satisfaction and fewer surprises.
Improved reliability, security posture, and risk management across systems and products.
Executive-level communication that is decision-oriented, clear, and consistent.

Qualifications

10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing products/platforms with demonstrated experience in AI.
Strong program/project delivery discipline; proven ability to manage multiple priorities with constrained resources.
Experience with AI, data governance, enterprise systems, and CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred).
Deep comfort partnering with Product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and delivery.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear decisions.
Commitment to the organization's mission.

Salary Range

$200,000 - $225,000
annually

Salary Disclaimer

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the organization's total compensation package for employees. Benefits include paid time off policy, hybrid or remote work schedule, medical/dental/vision insurance, paid parental leave, short term disability insurance, life insurance, and retirement plan with employer match.

The hiring organization is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
